scripts.title: Ryn SCP
scripts.features:
[Ryn Hub | SCP: Roleplay]
Dedicated script for SCP: Roleplay, built on top of the Exunys aimbot framework and extended with game-specific features.
Main Features
Aimbot: Three lock modes Rage (CFrame snap), Legit (MouseRel) and Smooth (lerp). Smart crosshair tracking: automatically follows the game's own weapon sight when a gun is equipped, so the FOV circle always stays on target.
Player ESP: Highlight enemies with customizable colors, rainbow and pulse effects. Full team check support for SCP:RP's complex team system.
Server Status Panel: Live monitoring of server events directly from ReplicatedStorage Nuke, Raid, Breach, Alarms and more. Get instant notifications when critical events activate.
Control Room: Highlight the CR_Switch in Sector 1 with a custom color. Chunk-safe reconnects automatically if the area unloads.
Visual Engine: RTX shaders, FPS Boost, custom FOV, and a cinematic multi-layer motion blur system.
Important: If you find any issues, report them in our Discord before leaving a bad review. Actively maintained and updated.
Key System: Join our Discord to grab the key it's in the key channel, quick and easy.
Credits to Exunys for the original aimbot framework base.
